generation.mode: built-in ImageGen whole-canvas edit with edit-target as Image 1 and canon as reference-only Image 2

lightingIsotropy.metric: 36-bin land-luminance-gradient magnitude peak divided by uniform-bin mean on the delivered source; final water-mask pixels and immediate neighbours excluded and gradients below 12 luminance units excluded
lightingIsotropy.visualCheck: No long cast-shadow field or whole-cell sun gradient is visible, but repeated pale rock caps and upper facets sit above darker vertical faces. The literal same-value-on-every-side rule is not met; the aggregate orientation metric cannot override that visible defect.

buildableVsSteepFraction.basis: manual estimated fraction of non-water land area at native source resolution
buildableVsSteepFraction.method: The broad gently rising grass-and-bare-rock inland shelf counts as buildable; the short west-edge face fragments and isolated column stacks count as steep; shoreline slabs, shingle, broken outcrops, scrub and heather make up the remainder.

crown.method: Full-frame visual census at native 1254 px found no conifer crowns, consistent with the sound-coast biome.

waterMask.encoding: opaque white water pixels on fully transparent non-water pixels; binary alpha
waterMask.method: Native-resolution cool-water classification followed by a smoothed north-connected shoreline trace and fill. The mask includes the complete visible Sound surface from the north edge through deep water, turquoise shallows, submerged slabs, shoreline wash, ripples and reflections; the full-canvas overlay was visually inspected.

refusalReasons: The highest-priority lighting rule fails visually: repeated pale upper rock facets and caps contrast with darker vertical and lower faces, revealing baked form-side value separation.
The north edge is not entirely water: the western 231 of 1254 north-edge pixels are land, so approximately 18.4 percent of the required water edge is blocked.

A dark channel is present toward the north-east, but it is not a clear approximately 12 m pinch between two broad level bare-rock standing banks; the required Sound-Narrows ground offer is incomplete.
openRisks: The water mask follows the water actually painted in the candidate and therefore correctly leaves the erroneous north-west land transparent; it does not invent water absent from the raw source.
Exact neighbour stitch quality and terrain quality remain director and owner visual decisions; mechanical checks do not establish visual acceptance.
No shipped-canvas bake or runtime validation was run because the task is quarantine-only; nothing was promoted to public or art-source.
